title: Secure Architecture & Capstone
description: Study capability isolation and sandboxes, human review for consequential actions, secure defaults and failure behavior, and capstone: harden a retrieval assistant. Each lesson includes a worked example and an applied practice task.

lessons.title: Capability isolation and sandboxes
lessons.description: Audit mounted resources and outbound access.
lessons.conceptOverview: Run risky operations in environments with limited filesystem, network and process access. A sandbox reduces impact only when its actual permissions match the intended boundary.
lessons.whyItMatters: Isolation must restrict actual resources and credentials.
lessons.engineerDeepDive: Run risky operations in environments with limited filesystem, network and process access. A sandbox reduces impact only when its actual permissions match the intended boundary.

sections.title: Concept
sections.content: Run risky operations in environments with limited filesystem, network and process access. A sandbox reduces impact only when its actual permissions match the intended boundary.

sections.title: Worked example
sections.content: A code runner is isolated from the UI process but still mounts production credentials.

sections.title: Practice & verification
sections.content: Audit mounted resources and outbound access. Write down your reasoning and check it against the concept before continuing.

keyTakeaways: Isolation must restrict actual resources and credentials.
commonMistakes: A separate process is automatically a sufficient sandbox.

lessons.title: Human review for consequential actions
lessons.description: Design an approval record tied to action parameters.
lessons.conceptOverview: Review should show the concrete action, target and effect before commitment. Bind approval to those details and expire it when material inputs change.
lessons.whyItMatters: Approval must cover the action actually executed.
lessons.engineerDeepDive: Review should show the concrete action, target and effect before commitment. Bind approval to those details and expire it when material inputs change.

sections.title: Concept
sections.content: Review should show the concrete action, target and effect before commitment. Bind approval to those details and expire it when material inputs change.

sections.title: Worked example
sections.content: A reviewer approves an export to one destination, but the destination changes before execution.

sections.title: Practice & verification
sections.content: Design an approval record tied to action parameters. Write down your reasoning and check it against the concept before continuing.

keyTakeaways: Approval must cover the action actually executed.
commonMistakes: An old approval authorizes any later variation of the action.

lessons.title: Secure defaults and failure behavior
lessons.description: Write a failure response that preserves the security invariant.
lessons.conceptOverview: Default to denied access when required authorization evidence is missing. Distinguish service errors from permission grants so dependency failures cannot accidentally enable privileged paths.
lessons.whyItMatters: Unavailable authorization must not become implicit permission.
lessons.engineerDeepDive: Default to denied access when required authorization evidence is missing. Distinguish service errors from permission grants so dependency failures cannot accidentally enable privileged paths.

sections.title: Practice & verification
sections.content: Write a failure response that preserves the security invariant. Write down your reasoning and check it against the concept before continuing.

keyTakeaways: Unavailable authorization must not become implicit permission.
commonMistakes: Authorization timeouts should grant access to preserve availability.

lessons.title: Capstone: harden a retrieval assistant
lessons.description: Deliver trust boundaries, enforcement checks, fixtures and an incident drill.
lessons.conceptOverview: Build a threat model and deterministic security harness for a retrieval assistant with one write tool. Include poisoned content, cross-tenant requests and uncertain retries using synthetic data.
lessons.whyItMatters: A security capstone verifies both allowed behavior and enforced boundaries.
